description: Follow-up: set config.policy.cooldown in composer.json once Composer 2.11 ships, so composer update applies a release-age gate too.

packageRules.description: PHP runtime comes from the digest-pinned php:8.5-apache image in the Dockerfile; the composer platform constraint stays ^8.5 (a human reverted the ^8.5.11 floor bump in ddcb764).

Every merge to main deploys to Cloud Run, so automerge only in the maintenance window infra uses: Tue/Wed/Thu 00:00-02:00 UTC. Pinned on all packages because the preset sets at any time for the mbologna/.github workflows.
